title: Silver Normalised spec
description: Format of one source's normalised spec (src/layers/silver/normalised/specs/{source}.yml). Meaning of every attribute: docs/normalised-spec/README.md.

source_system.description: Suffix of the silver_landing_{source} schema this spec reads from.

base_entities.description: Base and bridge entities, keyed by table name in silver_normalised_{source}.

extracted_entities.description: Extracted entities, keyed by singular domain name (N7).

dependency_tolerance.description: Per-case exceptions to N4's zero-exception rule; each needs a reason in the source change's design.md.

ignored_columns.description: Landing columns deliberately left out, as table.column; lets the drift check pass.

from.description: Landing table it is built from, as silver_landing_{source}.{table}.

natural_key.description: Natural key columns; become the first columns (N1). Not used on bridges, whose key is the parent's key plus the element.

history.description: scd2 keeps the Landing validity columns (N6); omit for none.

columns.description: Attributes kept on the entity. Not used on bridges.

extracted.description: Map of column to extracted entity (N10). On a bridge, the key is 'value' (explode) or 'attribute' (unpivot).

parent.description: Parent entity; with explode or unpivot, marks this entry as a bridge (N2).

explode.description: Flattens a delimited list column into one row per element (N2).

unpivot.description: Flattens a flag column family into one row per set flag (N2).

columns_like.description: SQL LIKE pattern selecting the column family.

keep_when.description: Flag value that produces a row.

attributes.description: Extra columns that depend on the entity's value, e.g. country_code (N7, N10).

entity.description: Base entity the dependency is checked on.

determinant.description: Column the dependent attribute depends on.

max_violations.description: Maximum violating determinant values accepted; their rows go to {entity}_quarantine.
